summary: P113 retest (frontend only) of the 2 HIGH bugs from iteration_112 + sanity. ALL PASS. (1) AdminPermissions full cycle verified: leads x Sales revoked (all 14 checkboxes unchecked -> Simpan enabled -> toast 'tersimpan'), page reload shows cell 'dicabut admin' with DICABUT ADMIN badge; opening the cell and clicking 'Kembalikan ke bawaan' [admin-permissions-cell-default] produced pending row 'leads · Sales: tidak boleh -> lihat sendiri, buat, ubah', Simpan became ENABLED, save succeeded and after reload the cell shows buat/ubah/lihat sendiri with MATRIKS badge. API verified: GET /api/admin/permissions matrix.leads.sales == ['create','update','view_own'] and new 'defaults' field present (defaults.leads.sales identical). (1b) 'Batalkan suntingan' [admin-permissions-cell-reset] still undoes an UNSAVED edit: toggling 'hapus' created pending change + enabled Simpan, clicking it removed the pending block and disabled Simpan. (2) CreateTaskDialog reopen: Tugas Baru -> jenis 'Unit' -> Batal -> reopen -> jenis still 'Unit' AND record combobox now returns 18 unit options (A-01 — Blok A ...), selected one, title TEST_P113_x, submit -> toast 'Tugas dibuat.' and task listed with 'To-do · unit'. Sanity: RBAC editor labels fully readable (lihat, lihat semua, lihat sendiri, buat, ubah, hapus, tugaskan, setujui, verifikasi, tanda tangan, terobos, batalkan, kelola, semua — no truncation); sales@sipro.co.id sees nav-item-leads and /leads loads 17 leads with no 403 after restore. Test data purged (1 TEST_P113 task deleted via Mongo).
